contract.note: The plain reading of 'serious problem' is fair and ordinary: recurring fabrication that harms reliability in uses that matter, without needing every model to fail. The window from January 1 to February 12, 2026 fits 'still' at publication.

Nothing in the packet shows hallucinations had become negligible. Because the benchmark is deliberately hard, it does not give an everyday rate, but the claim does not need one.
